context: Adding indexes to speed up filtering active users and subscribed newsletter recipients.
explanation: is_active and newsletter_subscribed each only have two possible values, and the table is overwhelmingly one of them, so the planner will almost always prefer a sequential scan over these indexes anyway. They just add write overhead and storage for a query pattern they will not actually be used for; a partial index scoped to the rare value would help, a plain index on a boolean does not. Should be rejected.
